**About Us**
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
  
  
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
  
  
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
  
  
**Job Description**
The Senior Manager, Consumer Platforms & Digital Experiences will be responsible for the delivery, governance, and continuous enhancement of Visa's consumer-facing platforms. Working across Product, Technology, Design, Marketing, Risk, Compliance, Legal, issuers, and strategic partners, the role will lead regional platform transformation initiatives, partner integrations, customer experience enhancements, platform migrations, and go-to-market execution. The incumbent will also drive roadmap prioritization, launch readiness, operational excellence, and the development of best-in-class customer journeys that improve adoption, engagement, and overall cardholder experience.
  
  
All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Claude etc.) to support everyday work.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Working closely with Regional Product teams, Sub-Regional stakeholders, Technology teams, Design and UX functions, Marketing, Risk, Compliance, Legal, and external partners, the Senior Manager will:
  
  

* Lead end-to-end delivery of strategic consumer platform initiatives, including migration of cardholders from legacy ecosystems to next-generation Visa platforms.
* Drive program governance, executive reporting, risk management, issue escalation, and stakeholder alignment across markets, partners, and internal teams.
* Own platform roadmaps, feature prioritization, localization requirements, and enhancement backlogs to improve customer experience, adoption, and engagement.
* Partner with Product, Design, and Technology teams to deliver best-in-class user journeys, onboarding experiences, and UI/UX enhancements.
* Oversee the rollout and expansion of intelligent consumer experience capabilities, including market onboarding, business readiness, adoption tracking, and performance optimization.
* Lead onboarding and integration of partners, benefits, and ecosystem capabilities, including travel, lifestyle, concierge, and future digital experiences.
* Act as the primary liaison between regional leadership, market teams, external partners, and engineering teams to ensure effective execution and delivery.
* Manage launch readiness, production deployments, operational handover, post-launch stabilization, and continuous platform improvement.
* Maintain integration roadmaps, dependency tracking, and delivery plans across Visa capabilities and third-party partner ecosystems.
* Identify and evaluate emerging technologies, capabilities, and partnerships to support the future evolution of Visa's consumer platforms and digital experiences.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* 10+ years of experience in digital product management, platform delivery, payments, technology, or transformation programs.
* Proven experience delivering customer-facing digital platforms, migrations, product launches, and large-scale transformation initiatives.
* Strong expertise in customer journey design, UX/UI, onboarding experiences, and digital engagement strategies.
* Experience managing product roadmaps, feature prioritization, enhancement backlogs, and market localization requirements.
* Demonstrated success leading partner onboarding, technology integrations, testing, launch readiness, and operational handovers.
* Strong program governance, executive reporting, risk management, and post-launch stabilization experience.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders and align cross-functional teams.
* Knowledge of digital platforms, mobile applications, AI-enabled capabilities, and emerging consumer engagement technologies.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and execution skills within complex, matrixed organizations.
* Experience within payments, consumer banking, loyalty, travel, lifestyle, or digital consumer ecosystems preferred.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

**About the Job**

OCS Services DMCC is looking for an experienced
**Operations Manager**
to lead multidisciplinary offshore projects and operations across multiple geographies. The role will oversee project execution, operational performance, commercial management, business development, and client relationships, ensuring the safe, timely, and profitable delivery of projects.

The ideal candidate will have strong experience in offshore construction, asset integrity, steel repair, structural fabrication, piping, coating, inspection, and maintenance services, along with proven capabilities in project leadership, bid and tender management, cost control, and business growth.

**About OCS Services**

OCS Services is a seasoned player in the oil and gas industry, delivering world-class services across offshore and onshore operations. As a joint venture between Planet Energy and BW Offshore, we specialize in Operations & Maintenance, Asset Integrity Management, and Integrated Crew Management. With global operations spanning Singapore, India, UAE, Brazil, Côte d’Ivoire, and Nigeria, we are strategically positioned to support energy production safely, sustainably, and reliably. Our expertise, cutting-edge technology, and commitment to sustainability enable us to drive excellence in complex energy projects around the world.

At OCS we’re guided by four core values that define everything we do – trust, driven, care and innovation.

**What you will do**

* Lead the safe, timely, and profitable execution of AIMS projects in line with contractual requirements.
* Oversee Project Managers, Project Engineers, and Crew Coordinators across multiple projects and geographical locations.
* Manage project planning, manpower, resources, schedules, budgets, vendors, and logistics.
* Monitor project performance, productivity, quality, costs, and timelines, implementing corrective actions where necessary.
* Ensure compliance with company QHSE requirements, applicable regulations, certifications, and statutory obligations.
* Manage project budgets, margins, cash flow, cost control, contract administration, variations, claims, and commercial risks.
* Drive business growth by identifying new clients, markets, and service opportunities.
* Lead and support techno-commercial proposals, bid and tender preparation, estimation, and submissions.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, consultants, vendors, and industry stakeholders.
* Lead, develop, and retain competent project and operational teams, promoting accountability and continuous improvement.
* Manage vendor evaluation, negotiations, procurement competitiveness, and supplier performance.
* Establish effective project reporting systems and provide regular business and operational performance updates to management.
* Conduct project and site visits as required, providing hands-on operational support across project locations.

**What we are looking for**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, preferably Mechanical, Structural, Marine, Naval Architecture, or a related discipline.
* 10–15 years of relevant experience in oil & gas, offshore construction, shipyards, or asset integrity services.
* Proven experience managing multidisciplinary offshore projects involving steel repair, structural fabrication, piping, coating, inspection, and/or E&I works.
* Experience working with offshore platforms, FPSOs, rigs, and marine vessels.
* Strong experience in project estimation, techno-commercial proposals, bids and tenders, and contract execution.
* Demonstrated expertise in project and operations management, commercial performance, cost control, and profitability.
* Strong client relationship management, business development, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience managing project teams, subcontractors, vendors, and client interfaces.
* Good knowledge of offshore fabrication, construction, maintenance practices, and HSE compliance.
* Strong leadership, analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
* Willingness to travel extensively across project locations.

**Preferred:**
Project Management certification and experience in detailed engineering, offshore fabrication/construction, shipyards, FPSOs, rigs, or oil & gas platforms.

**What you can expect**

* An opportunity to work with a global organisation in the oil & gas industry.
* A leadership role overseeing multidisciplinary offshore projects across multiple geographies.
* Exposure to diverse technical, operational, commercial, and business development activities.
* The opportunity to build strong client relationships and contribute to sustainable business growth.
* A professional environment that values trust, accountability, care, and innovation.

**Join Us**

If you have a strong background in offshore operations, asset integrity, project execution, and commercial management, and are ready to take on a leadership role in a dynamic global environment, we would love to hear from you.

Join OCS Services DMCC and contribute to delivering safe, reliable, and commercially successful offshore projects.

Individuals in the Customer Success Manager role have a passion for technology and the ambition to dive head-first into new challenges. We are looking for someone who can thrive with a high level of ambiguity and operate autonomously while maintaining a customer centric approach and helping to build the program. In this role you will also become a main point of contact for MongoDB end users by leveraging your technical and account management skills as well as acting as the account team leader across Sales, Professional Services, Solutions Architects, etc.
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Dubai for our hybrid working model.
  
  
Our ideal candidate will have
  
  

* 7+ years experience working in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, Professional Services or other similarly customer-centric role for a technical product (ideally consumption based)
* 4+ years experience being accountable for customer health and revenue realization for a defined book of business/portfolio of accounts for Forbes Global 2000 customers
* A background and passion for advocating on behalf of your customers - this role should act as an extension of our customers team within MongoDB
* A mind for technology - we’ll teach you about MongoDB and databases, but our customers and product are inherently technical and you should have an aptitude and curiosity to learn about those concepts
* The ability to act with a high level of autonomy, you will be expected to take full ownership of your customer portfolio and make key decisions to drive effective customer outcomes; including deciding when to include our executive team or c-suite in customer escalations, how to de-risk or de-escalate customer issues and conflict and advocating to internal teams including sales, professional services, etc
* An entrepreneurial mindset - you will be required to both deviate from established procedure and often build entirely new process or practices to ensure we best serve this customer segment
* A team player approach and passion for collaboration - this role will work with some of our most strategic growth customers so must align closely to Sales, Professional Services, Tech Services, and the broader MDB ecosystem
* Demonstrated continuing technical education (e.g., MongoDB DBA track, hyperscaler certifications)
* Prior exposure to database, cloud, and infrastructure technology is a plus

On a given day in this role you will:
  
  

* Work as a strategic advisor to your customer providing them with guidance on MongoDB best practices and their overall technology strategy; this could include running enablement sessions alone or with another internal MongoDB team members, advising the customer on strategies to optimize their technical environment or current spend with MongoDB, positioning and recommending product features and best practices to accelerate customers time to value and growth
* Guide customers through the customer journey to accelerate their time-to-value from MongoDB, overseeing the technical success plan from committed ARR to active consumption. Includes advising customers on on their deployment health & strategies for operating and maturing their MongoDB environments
* Proactively identify and mitigate technical risks for complex accounts by designing custom remediation plans and implementing best practices to pre-empt critical issues
* Facilitate the resolution of high-stakes customer challenges while identifying strategic opportunities to expand MongoDB usage through optimized technical solutions
* Collect feedback and identify roadblocks from customers to inform internal teams including Product, Professional Services, and Leadership on how MongoDB can build a stronger product and go to market organization
* Act as the link between our customers and product engineering to develop new innovative solutions. You will be key in building the future roadmap of our product by acting as the Product team’s eyes and ears in this field
* De-escalate and resolve critical customer issues and complaints by finding the best possible solution for both the customer and MongoDB; this could include anything from navigating a customer outage that has a financial impact on their business, to helping an application team devise a custom MongoDB solution or implementation for their critical application, no day is the same
* Build and execute account plans to mitigate risk and drive growth 3+ quarters out across your portfolio
* Lead in-person executive business reviews for strategic customers in your portfolio, including interfacing with C-suite executives and other technical leaders to align to business objectives and agree to a mutual success plan
* Work on strategic internal projects to help build the Customer Success program; our expectation is that anyone in this role has strong business acumen and the ability to create and teach best practices, new process, and enablement to the broader organization
* Document all customer interactions in internal systems, including Gainsight and Salesforce.com
* Provide feedback and guidance to leadership on key signals within MongoDB Atlas that indicate healthy or unhealthy customer accounts; as our product evolves, we’ll need to be constantly adjusting our engagement strategies based on these signals, which you’ll be in the best position to identify and share back with internal teams
* Manage the relationship with Sales Leadership and Account Executives in your territory, including reporting on business performance, training on best practices, and rolling out program updates to ensure sales people and leaders are abreast of best practices for interacting with Customer Success
* Forecast expected churn and growth to your senior leadership team
* Help interview, onboard and ramp new team members - as a more senior team member you will have an immediate role in who joins the team
* Act as a leader amongst your peers, running enablement sessions, product certifications and being vocal in team meetings to ensure those around you grow
* Fluent level of Arabic and English

**About MongoDB**
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
  
  
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
  
  
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
  
  
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!
  
  
MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.
  
  
MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

**Job Summary**
We are seeking an experienced, commercially minded professional to shape the UAE Implementation and Cash Client Service function within the evolving MENAP model. This role connects solution delivery, digital integration and ongoing service into one accountable client journey, accelerating revenue realisation and strengthening client relationships.
  
  
The successful candidate will lead through complexity and ambiguity, navigate Standard Chartered’s country, regional and global matrix, and influence partners beyond direct reporting lines. This is an opportunity to build a proactive, business-aligned service function while maintaining delivery discipline and client continuity through change.
  
  
**Strategy**

* Translate global and MENAP priorities into a focused UAE implementation and service roadmap, with clear outcomes and execution milestones.
* Embed a connected implementation and cash service proposition, reducing handover gaps and fragmented client ownership.
* Develop tier-based coverage: proactive, relationship-led engagement for Platinum and Gold clients, supported by scalable hub and digital servicing.
* Shape operating-model improvements with regional partners, balancing client needs, local requirements, capacity and sustainable cost.
* Partner with Sales, Coverage and Product on strategic client engagements, positioning implementation and service as differentiators in the Bank’s proposition.

**Business**

* Own implementation and service outcomes for the assigned portfolio, accelerating activation, supporting solution utilisation and protecting revenue retention.
* Build trusted relationships with senior Treasury and Finance stakeholders, understanding their operating models and anticipating service needs.
* Lead critical escalations with sound judgement, mobilising cross-functional owners and communicating realistic commitments to clients.
* Balance team capacity, productivity and cost across country and hub delivery, securing partner commitments where resources sit outside direct control.
* Represent the function in leadership forums, translating client insights, delivery constraints and achievements into actionable business decisions.

**Processes**

* Oversee delivery from deal handover and documentation through setup, integration, testing, training and transition to ongoing service, engaging service teams early.
* Establish clear ownership, milestones and service-level agreements with Technology, Channel Operations and other delivery partners to resolve dependencies and bottlenecks.
* Maintain disciplined use of implementation and service systems, with accurate records of risks, issues, complaints, turnaround times and agreed actions.
* Use service reviews, client feedback and root-cause analysis to prevent recurring issues and improve end-to-end delivery.
* Support RFPs and RFIs with credible delivery commitments; advance workflow simplification, setup automation, APIs and digital self-service to reduce client effort.

**People & Talent**

* Unite implementation and service teams around shared client outcomes, clear responsibilities and a collaborative, inclusive culture.
* Lead teams through organisational change with clarity and transparency, sustaining accountability and delivery while structures evolve.
* Coach colleagues in cash products, client engagement, digital integration and project management, strengthening judgement and problem-solving.
* Build succession and cross-training plans that develop future leaders, retain critical knowledge and support continuity across locations.

**Risk Management**

* Ensure delivery complies with applicable regulatory, legal and internal requirements, including those governing UAE, DIFC and cross-border activities.
* Identify operational, implementation and transition risks early, maintaining effective controls and escalation throughout change.
* Protect client information through appropriate access, confidentiality and information-barrier controls across teams and locations.
* Maintain reliable client and configuration data, robust reporting and business-continuity arrangements across country, hub and third-party dependencies.

**Governance**

* Clarify decision rights and accountability across the matrix, obtaining required approvals without allowing organisational boundaries to obscure client ownership.
* Use governance forums to resolve competing priorities, escalate recurring issues and track remediation to closure.
* Demonstrate ethical leadership and constructive challenge, ensuring changes to processes, resourcing and operating models are documented and appropriately controlled.

**Key Stakeholders**
**Internal**

* UAE, DIFC, MENAP and global business and functional leadership.
* Transaction Services Sales, CIB Coverage, Products teams
* Technology, Digital Channel Solutions, Channel Operations and offshore delivery hubs.
* CMO, Chief Operating Office, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Finance and HR partners.

**External**

* Senior Treasury, Finance and Regional Treasury Centre stakeholders.
* Corporate and institutional clients, including multi-market client teams.
* Client ERP partners and third-party technology, integration and service providers.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum 15 years’ experience in banking, financial services or a related industry, with substantial cash management and corporate client delivery expertise.
* Proven leadership in implementation, cash client service or related Sales and Coverage roles, with demonstrated ownership of complex client outcomes.
* Strong knowledge of cash products, payments, liquidity, digital channels and integration approaches, including APIs.
* Demonstrated success delivering complex, cross-border implementations and managing country and hub service dependencies.
* Ability to understand and navigate SCB’s matrix: country and functional mandates, regional and global priorities, and direct and dotted-line accountabilities.
* Evidence of leading transformation through ambiguity, resolving competing priorities and influencing senior stakeholders without relying on formal authority.
* Strong programme management, commercial judgement and executive communication skills, including credible engagement with senior clients.
* Experience navigating & dealing with geographically distributed teams; Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is advantageous.

**Position Summary**
When you work at Daktronics, you’ll be part of something amazing. We design, engineer, manufacture and support bold, eye-catching digital LED display technology and audio systems.
  
  
Our products bring excitement to professional, college and high school games. They attract customers for businesses around the world, and even provide direction for people as they travel, work and play.
  
  
As part of the Daktronics team, you’ll have interesting, impactful work with flexible opportunities. You can learn and grow at a company that provides competitive compensation and meaningful benefits – and the people are second to none.
  
  
**What will the work look like for me?**
We are currently seeking a Service Manager who will work closely with project managers and the service team. The Region Service Manager reviews project requirements, allocates resources, and coordinates service delivery to meet project timelines. The role also partners with sales to recommend suitable service plans and pricing and provides technical support for customer demonstrations and sales presentations as needed. The role combines service business planning, support for product introductions and lifecycle changes, service sales, escalation management, and leadership of the service team.
  
  
**Service Market Strategy**

* Define the service strategy for the market segment(s) working with other Region Service Managers and Market Managers.
* Analyze market trends, customer needs, and develop a Service value proposition for competitive differentiation.
* Understand key financial drivers of the service business, including revenue, gross margin, cost to serve, pricing, and return on investment.
* Use financial, operational, and customer data to make informed decisions regarding service strategies, offerings, pricing, and delivery models.
* Connect service delivery decisions to company financial goals, balancing customer value and experience with revenue growth, profitability, and cost.
* Create annual plans aligned to the market strategy, goals, and objectives.
* Evaluate financial tradeoffs and develop business cases to support strategic service investments and changes.
* Establish and monitor financial and operational measures to evaluate service performance and adjust strategies as needed.
* Collaborate with cross-functional leaders to identify opportunities that improve customer value while driving profitable service growth.

**Product–Service Strategy**

* Work with cross-functional teams to develop strategies for service delivery and support.
* Develop Service Support Strategies as it pertains to the Product Roadmap, comprising of new product introduction, new feature releases, retirement planning, and life-cycle administration.
* Collaborate with internal groups, such as product development, sales, and marketing to achieve the strategic objective.

**Selling Services**

* Ensure that services are aligned with the customer's value proposition and that customers understand the benefits of the services being offered.
* Contribute to Middle East sales goals by generating revenue through service offerings.
* Work closely with cross-functional teams to understand product offerings to ensure they meet customer needs and drive profitable revenue growth in the services that we offer.

**Service Delivery and Satisfaction**

* Responsible for service excellence, client satisfaction, and entitlement/contract performance by directing the team members who provide customer service including onsite technical services, service coordination, account management, repairs and inventory management.
* Manage field service responsibilities within region, focusing on employee experience and customer satisfaction.
* Collaborate with internal teams to identify and resolve issues, implement preventive measures, monitor service delivery metrics, and recommend corrective actions when necessary.
* Proactively encourage and support employees’ personal development plans through facilitating experiences, timely feedback and reflection. Utilize our performance development program.
* Utilize a comprehensive skills matrix to assess and document the growth of field engineers and service partners.
* Utilize Daktronics leadership development tools and methodologies to drive business results.
* Set workload expectations with Field Engineers to ensure workloads are balanced and assignments align with onsite support strategies.
* Ensure all assignments are completed on time and of high quality, following standard operating procedures and properly documented.
* Foster teamwork by emphasizing the relationship between quality work, customer service and satisfaction.
* Collaborate with HR on escalated issues and recommend staffing needs based on workload projections.
* Interview and hire employees aligned with company culture, compatibility, and growth potential.
* Follow established onboarding and training plans for new hires and existing team members.
* Delegate tasks and arrange corresponding work duties for service team.
* Swiftly respond to escalations and provide direction to effectively support the team.
* Lead and/or actively participate in larger improvement projects.
* Communicate changes and their importance to build consensus among the team and stakeholders.
* Ensure Employees and Contractors have a safe working environment.
* Travel on a regular basis (estimated 20-25% of time) to proactively build relationships and resolve issues with customers.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Where is this opportunity located?**
Position located in Dubai, U.A.E, the Region Service Manager leads the Daktronics Service team across the Middle East, Eurasia, and Africa. This role drives customer success by aligning resources and services with regional needs, delivering service excellence, and maintaining high levels of customer satisfaction. The Dubai-based team provides installations, event support, and a wide range of service calls across the region.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**To be considered for the Service Manager position, we require the following:**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, technical, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Demonstrated experience interacting with a variety of individuals in a positive, professional manner; prefer previous leadership experience.
* Engineering, Market, or Service experience preferred.
* Ability to learn quickly; prefer previously demonstrated ability to pick up technical concepts quickly.
* Strong technical writing and verbal communication skills required.

The Sr. Manager, MENA Supply Chain is the single-threaded owner of end-to-end logistics performance and build-out across the Middle East and North Africa region, with initial focus on the GCC (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain, Oman). This role designs, launches, and scales the regional logistics network, ensuring best-in-class cost, service, and delivery speed.

Operating as a core member of the regional leadership team, this role is the primary partner to the COO in-region. It translates global logistics strategy into scalable, high-performing operations and shapes key decisions based on regional realities, including cross-border customs flows, Arabic labeling, cash on delivery, and seasonal demand peaks such as Ramadan, Eid, and White Friday.

This is a hands-on leadership role combining strategy, execution, and team building during a critical scale-up phase.

**Job Expectations:**

### **Build and Own the MENA Supply Chain Setup**

  

* Lead the end-to-end setup of the MENA logistics network, including selection of the regional hub (for example a free zone warehouse in Dubai) and the set-up of an Arabic and bilingual labeling solution in the MENA warehouse.
* Define the flow model for the region: import and consolidation at the hub, in-country distribution, and cross-border linehaul to the other GCC markets and, over time, the wider MENA region.
* Ensure the initial setup is scalable, cost-efficient, and operationally robust.
* Ensure logistics is a proactive enabler of growth, not a constraint.

### **End-to-End Performance Ownership**

  

* Own regional logistics KPIs across (i) cost (transport, warehousing, handling, customs duties and fees), (ii) service levels (OTIF, delivery promise accuracy, first-attempt delivery, cash on delivery remittance accuracy), and (iii) speed (lead times, delivery SLAs by country and city tier).
* Drive trade-off decisions across transportation, warehousing, and inventory, including air versus sea inbound and hub versus in-country stock placement.
* Plan capacity and inventory for regional demand peaks (Ramadan, Eid, White Friday) and for summer heat constraints on temperature-sensitive products.
* Establish full visibility and control over performance drivers.

### **Strategic Partner to COO (Regional Translation and Feedback Loop)**

  

* Act as the go-to logistics counterpart to the COO in MENA.
* Translate global strategy into executable regional plans.
* Provide structured feedback to global teams on (i) market constraints, (ii) performance gaps, and (iii) optimization opportunities.
* Proactively challenge and refine global assumptions based on MENA realities, such as address quality, last-mile variability, and payment preferences.

### **Customs, Compliance and Regulatory Coordination**

  

* Drive cross-functional coordination to ensure MENA regulatory requirements are met across logistics operations, including product registration and import approvals with the relevant authorities in each market (for example SFDA in Saudi Arabia and the competent health and standards authorities in the UAE), GCC and country-level customs procedures, and halal and conformity requirements where applicable.
* Partner with Compliance, Legal, Marketing, customs brokers, and external partners on Arabic labeling, documentation (certificates of origin, attestations, import permits), and market-specific requirements.
* Translate compliance needs into operational execution across warehouses, 3PLs, customs brokers, and distribution flows, including free zone and mainland transfers and the GCC customs transit process.
* Identify risks and dependencies, such as shipment holds, registration delays, and duty classification disputes, and drive resolution across stakeholders.

### **Team Build and Leadership**

  

* Act as logistics representative within the regional leadership team.
* Lead a lean, high-performing regional logistics team, including a 3PL /Warehouse Manager, a Transportation and Customs Manager, and an Inventory Planner, with the ability to build a multi-cultural team across the region.
* Coach the team on carrier, 3PL, and customs broker strategy and execution, and collaborate with global to ensure global strategy and guardrails are followed.

### **Continuous Optimization and Scale**

  

* Identify and execute cost and efficiency improvements early.
* Optimize network design (warehouse footprint, in-country versus hub stock, routing, inventory placement), including the timing of a second node, for example in Saudi Arabia, as volumes grow.
* Optimize last-mile and cash on delivery operations, including carrier mix, delivery success rates, and returns handling.
* Lead regional logistics projects (process improvements, system enhancements).

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:**

Required:

* Proven experience building or scaling logistics operations (warehouse, transport, and inventory) in the region.
* Strong hands-on experience with 3PLs, carrier networks, customs brokers, and multi-country GCC distribution, including cross-border trucking and free zone operations.
* Working knowledge of GCC customs procedures and import requirements for regulated consumer products (health, food, personal care).
* Experience with e-commerce last-mile, including cash on delivery and returns, is strongly preferred.
* Proven ability to influence and align cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority.
* Experience operating in ambiguous, fast-scaling environments.
* Ability to operate at both strategic and deeply operational levels.
* Strong stakeholder management across global and regional teams, and the cultural fluency to work with partners across different MENA markets.
* Data-driven, execution-focused, and comfortable making trade-offs.
* Fluent English is required. Arabic is a strong advantage.

**Equipment Knowledge:**

  

* Experience with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
* Experience with Google Business Suite (Gmail, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Forms) preferred

**Experience Requirements:**

Generally requires a minimum 10 years in logistics / supply chain, with strong MENA or GCC exposure.

The role is based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, with frequent travel to the hub warehouse and port areas (for example Jebel Ali) and regular travel to other markets in the region, in particular Saudi Arabia (Riyadh, Jeddah, and Dammam).

The Head of IT Data Governance reports to the Group Head of IT and Security and is accountable for the quality, consistency and usability of the data the IT function relies on to run and improve itself. This is a governance role, not a data ownership role. The IT leader accountable for a service remains accountable for the data supporting that service (e.g. the Head of IT Infrastructure and Networks owns infrastructure and identity data, the Head of IT Platforms owns platform and application data, etc.). This role is responsible for implementing and operationalising data governance across IT, in accordance with the Enterprise Data Governance framework, policies and standards. **Dean of Students**

**Department:** Student Affairs / Pastoral Care
  
**Direct Reports:** As assigned

**Job Purpose**
---------------

The Dean of Students is responsible for promoting a safe, positive, inclusive, and supportive school environment in which students can thrive academically, socially, and personally.

The role provides strategic and day-to-day leadership of student wellbeing, behaviour, discipline, attendance, student engagement, and pastoral systems. The Dean works closely with school leadership, teachers, counsellors, parents, and support staff to ensure that student-related matters are managed consistently, fairly, and in accordance with school policies and procedures.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **1. Student Behaviour and Discipline**

* Lead and oversee the school's student behaviour and discipline processes.
* Ensure that behaviour expectations and consequences are applied consistently and fairly.
* Investigate and manage significant student behaviour incidents and disciplinary cases.
* Maintain accurate records of disciplinary incidents, interventions, and outcomes.
* Work with teachers and school leaders to develop appropriate behaviour interventions and support plans.
* Monitor recurring behaviour concerns and identify patterns requiring further intervention.
* Support restorative practices and strategies that promote accountability and positive behaviour.
* Escalate serious or repeated concerns to the appropriate member of the Senior Leadership Team.

### **2. Student Wellbeing and Pastoral Care**

* Promote a positive school culture focused on student wellbeing, belonging, respect, and inclusion.
* Work closely with school counsellors and pastoral staff to identify and support students requiring additional assistance.
* Monitor students who may be experiencing academic, social, behavioural, or personal difficulties.
* Coordinate appropriate interventions and follow-up support.
* Ensure student concerns are appropriately documented, managed, and escalated where required.
* Promote student voice and encourage students to take an active role in the school community.

### **3. Attendance and Student Engagement**

* Monitor student attendance, punctuality, and patterns of absence.
* Work with relevant staff and parents to address persistent attendance or punctuality concerns.
* Identify students who may be disengaged from school and coordinate appropriate interventions.
* Support initiatives designed to improve attendance, participation, and student engagement.

### **4. Safeguarding and Student Protection**

* Work collaboratively with the school's safeguarding team to promote student safety and welfare.
* Follow all school safeguarding policies and procedures.
* Report and escalate safeguarding concerns in accordance with school requirements.
* Maintain appropriate confidentiality when dealing with sensitive student matters.
* Contribute to safeguarding education, awareness, and prevention initiatives.

### **5. Parent and Community Relations**

* Serve as a key point of contact for parents and guardians regarding significant student behaviour, wellbeing, attendance, and pastoral matters.
* Conduct meetings with parents to discuss concerns, interventions, and student progress.
* Communicate professionally and constructively, particularly when dealing with sensitive or challenging situations.
* Build positive relationships with families and promote partnership between home and school.

### **6. Student Leadership and Activities**

* Support and develop student leadership opportunities.
* Encourage student participation in school activities, events, clubs, and community initiatives.
* Support student councils and other student leadership structures.
* Promote student responsibility, leadership, citizenship, and positive contribution to the school community.

### **7. School Culture and Community**

* Promote the school's values, expectations, and standards of conduct.
* Contribute to initiatives that strengthen school culture, student belonging, and community spirit.
* Support the organisation and delivery of assemblies, student events, campaigns, and wellbeing initiatives.
* Act as a visible and approachable presence around the school campus.

### **8. Staff Support and Collaboration**

* Provide guidance to teachers and staff regarding student behaviour, pastoral concerns, and appropriate interventions.
* Work collaboratively with Heads of School, Heads of Department, Year Leaders, Counsellors, SEN/SEND staff, and other relevant teams.
* Support staff in implementing consistent behaviour and pastoral expectations.
* Deliver or coordinate staff training related to student behaviour, wellbeing, safeguarding, and pastoral care where appropriate.

### **9. Data, Reporting and Continuous Improvement**

* Maintain accurate student records relating to behaviour, attendance, wellbeing, and interventions.
* Analyse student behaviour and attendance data to identify trends and areas requiring action.
* Prepare reports for school leadership as required.
* Evaluate the effectiveness of student support and behaviour systems.
* Recommend improvements to policies, procedures, and student support programmes.

### **10. Leadership and School Operations**

* Contribute to the development and implementation of school policies relating to students.
* Participate in leadership meetings and relevant school committees.
* Support the Principal and Vice Principal with student-related matters and school-wide initiatives.
* Assist with crisis management and major student incidents when required.
* Undertake other duties reasonably assigned by the Principal or designated member of the Senior Leadership Team.

**Qualifications and Experience**
---------------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Education, Psychology, Social Sciences, Leadership, or a related field.
* Relevant postgraduate qualification or leadership qualification is desirable.
* Previous experience in a school-based pastoral, student affairs, behaviour, safeguarding, or leadership role.
* Experience managing complex student behaviour and wellbeing matters.
* Experience working collaboratively with parents, teachers, school leaders, and external professionals.
* Knowledge of safeguarding principles and child protection practices.
* Experience in an international or multicultural school environment is desirable.

**Skills and Competencies**

* Strong understanding of student behaviour, wellbeing, and pastoral care.

* Ability to remain calm and professional in challenging situations.

**Personal Attributes**

The successful candidate will demonstrate:

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

We are building one of the region's most ambitious e-commerce platforms: high-traffic, multi-region, and engineered for scale. Our platform — around fifteen backend services, a web storefront and native mobile apps — handles thousands of orders every day, and every one of them depends on infrastructure that is fast, observable, and always on.

*This is a founding role for our DevOps & SRE function. You will move our platform off a managed commerce PaaS onto infrastructure we own, set the reliability bar for every engineering squad, and build the team that keeps it there.*

**ABOUT THE FUNCTION**

DevOps & SRE sits at the centre of Lulu's e-commerce engineering. We own the platform every squad ships on: cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, CI/CD, data stores, networking, security and observability. We run on-call and incident response, define SLOs with product squads, and make sure peak sales events are boring. Over the next 12–18 months our biggest goal is migrating our workloads from a vendor-managed platform onto our own cloud footprint. We are deliberately keeping the team lean and AI-first: we expect AI agents and assistants to take on a large share of the toil — writing infrastructure-as-code and pipelines, triaging alerts, drafting runbooks and postmortems — so a small team can run a large platform.

**Core ownership:**
Cloud infrastructure & Kubernetes, CI/CD & release engineering, observability stack, data-store operations, on-call & incident management, platform migration

**WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON**

* Lead the migration of our e-commerce platform from a vendor-managed PaaS onto our own cloud infrastructure: discovery, target architecture, migration waves, cutover and decommissioning
* Design and run production Kubernetes for ~15 Python/Django services (DRF, Celery workers and beat), a Next.js storefront and supporting APIs, with Helm and GitOps-based delivery
* Operate and scale the stateful core of the platform: PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka and Elasticsearch — HA, backups, point-in-time recovery, upgrades and capacity planning
* Build an open-source observability stack across metrics, logs, traces and profiles (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo, OpenTelemetry) that every squad uses day to day
* Define SLIs, SLOs and error budgets with product squads for checkout, order management, delivery promise and storefront APIs, and alert on what customers actually feel
* Modernise CI/CD on Bitbucket Pipelines: build and release standards, progressive delivery (canary, blue-green), automated rollbacks and idempotent release scripts
* Codify everything as infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/OpenTofu), including networking, IAM, secrets management and environment provisioning
* Prepare the platform for peak events — load testing, autoscaling, capacity reviews and game days — so sale days run without incident
* Run incident response and blameless postmortems, and drive the reliability fixes that come out of them
* Own cloud cost visibility and optimisation (FinOps), making sure we spend where it buys reliability or speed

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

**Scope & Impact**

* Own multi-quarter, multi-team infrastructure and reliability goals, with the migration programme as the headline deliverable
* Make independent technical decisions on open-ended problems — build vs buy, managed vs self-hosted, which tool and when — grounded in business context and cost
* Drive cross-team initiatives across backend, frontend, mobile and data squads, optimising for the platform as a whole rather than any one team

**Technical Craft**

* Design infrastructure that meets its reliability, security and cost objectives and stays simple enough for a small team to run
* Debug non-deterministic production issues across the stack — kernel, network, container runtime, database, application — that escape less experienced engineers
* Automate toil relentlessly; treat runbooks, dashboards and alerts as code that is reviewed, versioned and tested
* Identify and retire technical risk early: single points of failure, untested backups, unpatched dependencies, end-of-life runtimes
* Champion an AI-first engineering culture — use AI tools and assistants to speed up infrastructure work, incident analysis and documentation

**Leadership & Strategy**

* Hire, coach and grow DevOps and SRE engineers; set the hiring bar and run interview loops for the function
* Keep the team lean by design — build automation and AI-assisted workflows that let a small team operate the whole platform, and measure the efficiency gains they deliver
* Design a sustainable on-call rotation with clear escalation paths, severity levels, incident command roles and stakeholder communication
* Establish reliability practices across engineering: SLO reviews, production-readiness reviews, postmortem culture, change management and DR drills
* Measure and report engineering health with DORA metrics, SLO attainment and cost dashboards; present them to engineering and business leadership
* Manage vendor relationships and infrastructure budget, and make the case for investment with data
* Act as a Culture Leader — partner with engineering leadership to set the tone, foster psychological safety and champion inclusive practices

**MUST-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS**

These are non-negotiable. We need engineers who can hit the ground running with our stack and ways of working.

* 7+ years in DevOps, SRE or platform engineering, including 2+ years leading or acting as technical lead for an infrastructure or reliability team
* Expert-level Kubernetes in production — cluster design, networking, ingress, autoscaling (HPA, KEDA, cluster autoscaler), upgrades and troubleshooting
* Deep experience with at least one major cloud (GCP preferred; AWS or Azure acceptable): VPC design, IAM, load balancing, managed databases and cost optimisation
* Strong infrastructure-as-code with Terraform or OpenTofu, plus Helm and a GitOps tool (Argo CD or Flux)
* Set up end-to-end observability and monitoring from scratch using open-source tools — metrics (Prometheus, Grafana, Alertmanager), logs (Loki or ELK/OpenSearch), distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry with Tempo or Jaeger) and error tracking (self-hosted Sentry) — covering infrastructure, Kubernetes, databases, queues and application code, with dashboards, alert routing and on-call integration that teams rely on
* Practical SRE experience: defining SLIs/SLOs and error budgets, symptom-based alerting, incident command and blameless postmortems
* CI/CD expertise (Bitbucket Pipelines, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI or Jenkins) with deployment strategies such as canary and blue-green

* Experience running Python web services and async workers (Celery or similar) in production, ideally in e-commerce, retail or other high-traffic consumer platforms

These will set you apart and accelerate your impact, but aren't required on day one.

* Hands-on leadership of at least one production migration between cloud providers (e.g. AWS to GCP, Azure to AWS) or from a managed PaaS to self-managed infrastructure — planning, data migration, cutover and rollback

AECOM Middle East Infrastructure delivers civil and utility infrastructure design across the UAE and Saudi Arabia. The Digital Delivery / BIM team models and documents wet utilities, dry utilities, MEICA and smart technology networks for these projects, and is responsible for the quality, coordination and timely issue of the information that comes out of them.

**Purpose of the role**

Supervise a group of BIM team leads delivering concurrent infrastructure projects, and carry the accountability for what that group produces. On the team's responsibility assignment matrix this is the second most accountable position after the BIM Manager: it owns resource deployment, clash resolution, validation of model and drawing submissions, and the final check before anything is issued for design review.

**Key responsibilities**

**Deployment and progress**

* Own the deployment of resource across the group's disciplines, and rebalance it as project demand moves.
* Chair production progress meetings and discipline coordination meetings for the group.
* Own the key performance indicators reported for the group, and the progress position on clash and issue resolution.
* Onboard third parties brought in to support the project team.

**Delivery management**

* Own model and drawing delivery for the group, against the master information delivery plan and the discipline task information delivery plans.
* Own the standards that the work is produced to: NOC data standardisation, base plan standardisation, base plan and title block milestone requirements, and the authoring tool template files.
* Own data shortcut setup and the part catalogue or object library arranged for each project.
* Own the implementation of design automation in support of the production teams.
* Maintain the single source of truth for the 2D extraction of drawings.

**Validation and issue**

* Validate discipline model submissions against the model checklist, and BIM data for GIS submission against the GIS checklist.
* Own the drawing checklist and CAD standard compliance check.
* Perform the final drawing sanity check before anything is issued to discipline or interdisciplinary review.
* Own quantity take-off compliance where it feeds the bill of quantities.

**Clash and interface**

* Own the clash resolution activity for the group, end to end.
* Issue direction and provide the solution where a clash needs a decision.
* Agree the solution with the engineering team and establish which modeller carries the fix.
* Ensure interfaces and tie-ins between disciplines and with third parties are coordinated.

**People**

* Deliver internal training on the authoring tools, and confirm the group's capability against project requirements.
* Manage performance and development for the team leads reporting to the role.
* Support recruitment, technical interviewing and onboarding.

**Technical requirements**

* Civil 3D and AutoCAD to an advanced level, with a working command of Navisworks for clash and interface management.
* Autodesk Construction Cloud or BIM 360, including model coordination spaces and package sharing.
* ISO 19650 in practice: BIM execution plan, master and task information delivery plans, information states and level of information need.
* Data shortcuts, part catalogues, object styles and authoring templates at a level that lets the role set them for others.
* Local authority requirements in the UAE and Saudi Arabia, including utility depth, cover and corridor allocation standards.

**Qualifications and experience**

* Degree in Civil Engineering, or a diploma with equivalent proven experience.
* Ten or more years in infrastructure design production, of which at least five supervising multiple teams or a large production team in an engineering consultancy.
* Demonstrable record of delivering to ISO 19650 on live projects; formal certification is an advantage.
* Middle East consultancy experience strongly preferred.
* Fluent written and spoken English.

**Behaviours we are selecting for**

* Holds a standard consistently, including when programme pressure argues against it.
* Takes the decision on a clash rather than letting it circulate.
* Plans resource ahead of demand rather than reacting to a shortfall.
* Develops people deliberately, and is judged on their progression.

**How performance is measured**

* On-time issue of the group's deliverables against the agreed programme.
* Model and drawing checklist failures found after the role's own validation.
* Clash resolution rate and the ageing of open clashes in the group.
* Utilisation and bench time across the group against the deployment plan.

**Description**
Last mile demand changes by the hour, the day and the season, and our delivery capacity needs to flex with it. Join Amazon's Last Mile team in the Middle East, Africa and Turkey to design how our Delivery Service Partner (DSP) network flexes to meet demand, from 15-minute Quick Commerce to Core delivery.
  
  
As Program Manager, Flexible Capacity, you will own flexible capacity models from first idea to launch and scale: part-time and flexible delivery associate models, shift design and rostering. You will start in our fastest services and take what works into Core delivery, adapting each model to the labour rules, partner base and market of each country. You will own the problem, the model, the economics, the compliance, the launch and the results.
  
  
You don't need to be an expert in every area on day one. You do need to know how to take a programme from a blank page to measurable results, and how to build mechanisms that keep working after you move on.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Own the roadmap: define the problem, set the baseline and build the business case for flexible capacity models across fast delivery services and Core delivery.
* Design the model: work with DSP partners and station teams on shift patterns, rostering, part-time and flexible delivery associate models, and the incentives that make them work.
* Build the economics: model cost to serve, utilisation and DSP partner profitability with Finance, so cost comes down rather than moving elsewhere.
* Make it compliant: turn labour and transport rules in each country into model design, SOPs and partner guidance, working with Legal and People Experience.
* Pilot, then scale: run pilots with clear success metrics and guardrails, decide what to scale, change or stop, and adapt each model by country.
* Tech and mechanisms: write business requirements with Tech and Product teams for scheduling and capacity tools, and set up the reporting around them.
* Lead change: check operational readiness, manage risks and approvals, and build communication plans across stations and DSPs.
* Report and write: own programme metrics, contribute to business reviews and annual planning, and write clear, data-backed documents for senior leaders.

A day in the life
  
  
You start by checking how capacity matched demand yesterday: where routes went unstaffed, where associates sat idle and what it cost. Mid-morning, you're with a DSP owner and a station manager testing a new shift pattern and what it means for their team and their margin. After lunch, you're with Finance on the business case for taking a part-time model into Core delivery, and with Legal checking it works under local labour rules. You finish by writing the update for senior leaders: what the pilot showed, what you recommend and what you need from them.

**Job Description:**

**1. Job Purpose**
------------------

To carry out all surveying, setting-out verification, and dimensional control activities ensuring that the Contractor's setting-out, levels, alignments, and as-built records comply with the approved IFC drawings, project specifications, and the requirements of the Client and relevant Dubai authorities (DM, RTA, DEWA). The Land Surveyor provides the Resident Engineer with independent verification of all survey-related works and ensures full traceability to the Dubai Local Transverse Mercator (DLTM) coordinate system and DMD (Dubai Municipality Datum) vertical datum.

**2. Key Responsibilities**
---------------------------

**2.1 Survey Control & Datum**

* Establish, verify, and maintain primary and secondary survey control networks on site, tied to DLTM and DMD via Dubai Municipality benchmarks.
* Carry out periodic verification of control stations to confirm stability and accuracy.
* Maintain the Project Control Register, including coordinates, elevations, descriptions, and check records.
* Verify the Contractor's survey control submissions and recommend approval to the Resident Engineer.

**2.2 Setting-Out Verification**

* Independently check the Contractor's setting-out of roads, bridges, tunnels, structures, drainage, and utility corridors against approved IFC drawings.
* Verify horizontal alignment, vertical alignment, cross-sections, super-elevation, gradients, and chainages.
* Sign off setting-out check sheets prior to commencement of works and maintain the setting-Out Register.
* Issue Survey Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) where setting out does not comply with approved drawings or tolerances.

**2.3 Roadworks Surveying**

* Verify levels and lines for subgrade, subbase, aggregate base course (ABC), and asphalt layers (binder and wearing course).
* Check kerbs, gullies, channels, manhole covers, road markings, and signage positions.
* Confirm camber, crossfall, super-elevation transitions, and gradient compliance with approved geometric design.
* Carry out asphalt level checks before and after paving to verify thickness compliance.

**2.4 Bridges & Structures**

* Verify setting-out and levels for piles, pile caps, piers, abutments, bearings, girders, deck slabs, parapets, and expansion joints.
* Check geometric control of formwork, falsework, and reinforcement positioning.
* Carry out monitoring surveys for movement, settlement, and deflection of structures during and after construction.
* Verify final geometry of bridge decks, including camber, alignment, and joint positions.

**2.5 Tunnels**

* Verify tunnel alignment control, including horizontal and vertical setting-out of the tunnel axis.
* Check setting-out for segmental linings, cross-passages, shafts, portals, and tunnel finishes.
* Carry out convergence and settlement monitoring of tunnel sections and surrounding structures.
* Coordinate with the Contractor's tunnel survey team on TBM guidance and as-built tunnel geometry.

**2.6 Infrastructure Utilities**

* Verify setting-out of water, sewerage, irrigation, district cooling, telecom, and electrical networks.
* Check trench alignment, invert levels, gradients, and connection points to existing utilities.
* Confirm chamber, manhole, and valve positions and levels.
* Coordinate with DEWA, DM Sewerage, Etisalat/du, and Empower surveyors during joint surveys and tie-ins.

**2.7 Topographic & Pre-Construction Surveys**

* Witness and verify topographic surveys, pre-construction condition surveys, and existing utility surveys carried out by the Contractor.
* Check existing levels, ground conditions, and surface features against design assumptions.
* Identify and report any discrepancies between design and existing site conditions to the Resident Engineer.

**2.8 Quantity Verification Support**

* Carry out joint surveys with the Contractor and Quantity Surveyor for measurement of earthworks (cut/fill), excavation, backfill, and pavement layers.
* Prepare cross-sections, longitudinal sections, and volume calculations using survey software (Civil 3D, AutoCAD, Trimble Business Center).
* Support the Quantity Surveyor with survey-based quantity verification for interim payment applications.

**2.9 As-Built Surveys & Records**

* Verify the Contractor's as-built surveys for all completed works and ensure compliance with project specifications and DM/RTA submission requirements.
* Check accuracy, completeness, and format of as-built drawings prior to recommendation for approval.
* Maintain a comprehensive As-Built Survey Register and ensure traceability to hand over documentation.

**2.10 Instruments & Calibration**

* Maintain Consultant's survey instruments (Total Stations, GNSS/RTK GPS, automatic and digital levels, prisms, and accessories) in good working order.
* Verify that all Contractor's survey instruments are calibrated by accredited laboratories with valid certificates.
* Maintain a Calibration Register for all survey equipment used on the project.

**2.11 Documentation & Reporting**

* Maintain comprehensive survey records: control sheets, setting out check sheets, level books, monitoring records, NCRs, and as-built data.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly survey activity reports for the Resident Engineer.
* Support authority audits and submissions to DM, RTA, and DEWA with verified survey data.

**2.12 Coordination & Reporting**

* Report directly to the Resident Engineer on all survey-related matters.
* Coordinate with Site Engineers, Materials Engineer, Quantity Surveyor, and the Contractor's Survey Manager and team.
* Attend technical meetings, progress reviews, and joint surveys with authorities.

**3. Qualifications & Experience**
----------------------------------

* **Education:** B.Sc. in Surveying / Geomatics / Civil Engineering, or a recognized Diploma in Land Surveying with relevant professional experience.
* **Experience:** Minimum 10 years' experience in land surveying on construction projects, with at least 7 years on major infrastructure projects (roads, bridges, tunnels, utilities) and a minimum of 3 years in the UAE/GCC.
* **Certifications:** Dubai Municipality / RTA approval as Land Surveyor is highly preferred.
* **Knowledge:** Dubai Local Transverse Mercator (DLTM) projection, DMD vertical datum, DM and RTA survey specifications, geometric design standards, and infrastructure construction tolerances.
* **Skills:** Expert use of Total Stations, GNSS/RTK GPS, digital levels, and 3D laser scanners. Strong proficiency in AutoCAD, Civil 3D. Good technical report writing, attention to detail, and effective communication.

**4. Reporting Line**
---------------------

The Land Surveyor reports directly to the Resident Engineer and works in close coordination with the Assistant Resident Engineer, Site Engineers, Materials Engineer, Quantity Surveyor, and the Contractor's Survey Manager and survey team.

* Coordinate with OEMs, manufacturers, vendors, and technical service providers to address engineering issues, review technical recommendations, and ensure effective delivery of required technical services.
* Maintain effective working relationships with internal departments and external stakeholders to facilitate technical coordination, information sharing, and resolution of New Energy Bus engineering issues.

**Engineering Improvement & Technology Application**

* Identify and recommend engineering improvement initiatives, technology applications, and maintenance solutions to enhance New Energy Bus reliability, maintainability, and operational efficiency.
* Coordinate engineering studies and technical assessments in collaboration with relevant specialists and external service providers to address fleet performance issues and improve engineering practices.
* Apply relevant data analysis and statistical techniques to monitor asset condition, identify failure trends, and support the optimization of maintenance strategies.

* Monitor employee performance, identify competency and development requirements, and support appropriate training and knowledge-sharing initiatives.
* Ensure effective utilization and allocation of available manpower and technical resources in line with operational priorities and business requirements.

A government ministry in Qatar is building a national citizen-facing super app. It brings services from many government and private-sector bodies into one mobile app. Each release is tested at several levels by different parties. We need one person to make those levels work as a single, joined-up process.

As Test Manager, you will own the test process for the app: the plan, the standards, the evidence and the reporting across all test levels. The delivery vendor runs unit, integration, end-to-end and regression testing, and you set what it must test and show. Your main focus is user acceptance testing (UAT) and the hand-over between levels, so that nothing is tested twice and nothing is missed. You will lead the client’s UAT testers and report to Programme Management.

**What you’ll do**

* Define the test levels, with entry and exit criteria, and keep one test plan per release
* Agree what the vendor tests and what evidence it hands over, review its results before UAT starts, and send work back when the evidence falls short
* Work with the vendor and the hosting team so test environments and masked or synthetic test data are ready on time
* Own the regression pack: decide what is automated and what is manual, keep it current, and make sure it runs before every release
* Make sure end-to-end tests cover complete user journeys, including payments and connections to partner systems
* Plan and lead UAT for each release, and support the representatives of partner organisations as they test and sign off their own services
* Run one defect process across all levels: severity definitions, triage with the vendor and Product Owner, and closure with evidence. Analyse defects that slipped through and tighten the tests.
* Report test status in plain figures, with a readiness recommendation for each service
* Give the Change and Release Manager the test evidence for each release
* Support go-live readiness and the first limited release to real users

**What you’ll bring**

* 7+ years in software testing, including at least 3 years as a test manager or test lead covering more than one test level, on a system delivered by two or more suppliers
* A strong record writing test strategies and plans, and judging when testing is complete enough
* Experience planning and leading UAT with business users who are not professional testers
* A sound grasp of test automation and CI/CD. You can judge a supplier’s automation; you don’t need to write the code.
* Testing experience with mobile apps (iOS and Android), web services and APIs
* Jira or a similar tool (Xray, Zephyr, Azure DevOps Test Plans)
* Experience leading testers and getting results from several suppliers and organisations with different priorities
* Clear written and spoken English, including reports for non-technical readers
* A bachelor’s degree in computer science, IT, engineering or a related field

**Nice to have**

* Testing government, regulated-sector or payment services
* ISTQB Foundation or Advanced Test Manager
* Arabic

* Onsite at the client’s premises in Doha
* Extended or weekend hours may be needed in the weeks before go-live
* The role involves confidential government test data

Reporting to the Head of Partner Strategy, you lead the decision on which partners are brought into Echelon’s portfolio and under what terms. Each recommendation goes to the leadership team after you apply four key tests: technology, industry, layer, and mutual fit. You collaborate with the CRO’s technical principal and our engineers for technical diligence, tap account teams for customer insight, and leverage Partner Sourcing and Intelligence to challenge and enhance recommendations. * **The right layer:** Determine where the partner sits in the stack and if that layer needs filling, strengthening, or should remain open.
* **The right mutual fit:** Assess strategic intent, commercial ambition, ways of working, and appetite for joint investment, ensuring mutual commitment.
* **A portfolio that holds:** Evaluate each partner’s addition relative to our roadmap and signed partners, checking for gaps, overlaps, or competition, and ensuring a cohesive market offering.

* Monitor daily training performance and identify risks to completion or operational readiness.
* Generate and maintain reports on training status, expiries, and recovery plans.
* Provide data-driven insights to support planning and decision-making.

**Position Summary**
The Regional Head of Customer Success (RHCS) is the senior customer-facing leadership role for Global Services within a defined geographic region. The role carries end-to-end accountability for customer outcomes across all four Lines of Service; Contact Center (Customer Experience Centers), Technology & Service Operations, Financial Services, and Field Services, spanning both active deployment programs and steady-state service operations.
  
  
The RHCS operates as the single point of regional accountability for service governance, escalation management, and customer satisfaction, ensuring that Service Delivery Managers (SDMs), Technical Account Managers, Business Analysts, and Release Management & Planning resources are aligned, coordinated, and executing to Global Services standards. While SDMs retain program-level accountability, the RHCS provides the regional leadership layer that drives consistency, escalation resolution, and continuous improvement across the portfolio.
  
  
The role operates in a matrix environment. Multiple SDMs carry a dotted-line relationship to the RHCS, as do Release Management & Planning resources, Business Analysts, and Technical Account Managers embedded across programs in the region. The RHCS provides direction, prioritization alignment, and performance oversight across these resources without replacing the direct-line reporting structure of each function.
  
  
This role reports directly to the Senior Director, Customer Success and serves as the primary escalation and leadership interface between the regional program portfolio and the Global Services executive team.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Regional Customer Success Leadership – Serve as the senior customer success leader for the region, accountable for the quality, consistency, and outcome of all customer-facing service activity across deployment and operations. The RHCS sets the standard for customer engagement across all four Lines of Service, drives a customer-first culture across SDMs and dotted-line functions, and ensures that every program in the region reflects Global Services delivery standards.
* Deployment & Program Delivery Oversight – During active deployment phases, including program change, BAU change, security change, and maintenance activities, ensures that all Lines of Service are mobilized, coordinated, and executing to contracted scope and schedule. Coordinate readiness activities across Contact Center, Technology & Service Operations, Field Services, and Financial Services ahead of major go-lives and change events. Ensure SDMs are embedded and effective across all active deployment programs within the region and that customers receive proactive, high-quality engagement throughout the deployment lifecycle.
* Service Operations & BAU Performance – In steady-state operations, ensure that contracted SLAs and KPIs are consistently met or exceeded across all programs and Lines of Service within the region. Maintain regional oversight of service performance, incident management, ticket resolution, and escalation handling. Ensure SDMs are driving operational discipline, meeting response and resolution targets, and managing customer satisfaction proactively. Provide consolidated regional performance visibility to the Senior Director, Customer Success, including risk flags, trend analysis, and improvement initiatives.
* Escalation Ownership & Management – Own regional escalation management across all programs, ensuring timely resolution of high-severity incidents and complex service failures. Act as the primary escalation point of contact for SDMs across programs within the region. Support SDMs in managing escalations and ensuring clear ownership and rapid resolution pathways. Coordinate cross-functional responses across technical, operational, and service teams. Engage customers directly on critical incidents where issues exceed SDM scope. Align SDMs, Technology & Service Operations leadership, and functional teams to resolve complex, cross-program, or systemic issues. Ensure escalation closure with documented root-cause analysis and corrective actions. Provide timely visibility and structured updates to leadership on all high-priority issues. Reduce the escalation burden on the Senior Director, Customer Success and CSO by owning regional resolution pathways end-to-end. Drive consistent escalation handling practices across the region.
* Cross-Line-of-Service Coordination – Coordinate service delivery across all four Lines of Service to ensure seamless, integrated customer outcomes. Resolve cross-functional dependencies, manage service handoffs, and ensure that no program or customer falls through the gaps between service functions. Lateral engagement with Contact Center, Technology & Service Operations, Field Services, and Financial Services leadership is a core and ongoing requirement of this role.
* SDM Performance & Capability – Provide direction, coaching, and performance oversight to SDMs with a dotted-line relationship to this role. Ensure SDMs implement best practices in service governance, customer engagement, and escalation handling. Monitor SDM performance against regional standards and intervene where gaps are identified. Drive capability development across the SDM population in the region, reinforcing consistent application of Global Services frameworks.
* Matrix Resource Coordination – Coordinate the activities of dotted-line resources, including SDMs, Business Analysts, Release Management & Planning functions, and Technical Account Managers, across programs in the region. Ensure these resources are prioritized effectively, operating to common standards, and contributing to regional customer outcomes in a coordinated manner. Navigate the matrix structure to remove blockers and align effort across functions.
* Standardization & Continuous Improvement – Reinforce standardized governance cadence, reporting structures, KPI frameworks, and service improvement methodologies across all programs within the region. Identify best practices from individual programs and drive replication across the regional portfolio. Continuous improvement is approached not only at the program level but at the regional services model level.

**Key Performance Metrics**

* Escalation Resolution Time – Time to resolve high-severity incidents from point of escalation to closure, tracked per priority tier across all programs in the region.
* Client Satisfaction (CSAT / NPS) – Aggregated customer satisfaction and net promoter scores across all programs in the regional portfolio.
* SLA & KPI Compliance Rate – Percentage availability, percentage response within SLA, resolution times, and percentage abatements across Non-Field and Field Services, covering Contact Center, Technology & Service Operations, and Field Services.
* Incident Resolution Effectiveness – Reduction in repeat incidents and mean time to resolution versus baseline, tracking improvement across all Lines of Service within the region over time.
* Unclosed Ticket Volume – Count of open and aged tickets across Contact Center, Technology & Service Operations, and Field Services per program within the region.
